configuration.runtime: Browser local file; Node.js v22.23.4 for tests
configuration.applicationFramework: None; portable HTML, local classic JavaScript, and local CSS only
configuration.freshnessBoundary: Inclusive; 30000 ms is fresh and 30001 ms is stale
configuration.aggregateSample: Informational illustration only, not targeted evidence or a required route-validation check
configuration.persistence: In-memory only; no storage or server

bdd.format: Concrete Given/When/Then scenarios and one scenario outline
bdd.execution: Rules exercised by built-in node:test and real-browser DOM interactions; no Gherkin parser or package was installed.
coverage: All three required candidates fresh-ready; optional instance and dependency failures remain non-gating
One required candidate unready despite a healthy reply
Misleading healthy aggregate sample with missing and unknown required evidence
Stale, missing, failed, unknown, wrong-identity, future-dated, and duplicate required evidence
Inclusive freshness boundary and absent required candidate records
Required dependencies block on failed, missing, unknown, or ambiguous observations
Missing/stale aggregate samples do not become extra blanket gates
Empty or ambiguous declared required pools fail closed
Keyboard edits and independent expected-versus-observed prediction checks
Separate verification, actual user-impact categories, cleanup, and native-proof limits

red.stage: After BDD and focused assertions, before readiness behavior implementation
red.implementationAtRun: Importable minimal evaluatePool stub returned allowAdmission=null with empty candidate/trace collections
red.representativeFailure: ERR_ASSERTION: null !== true (all required fresh-ready admission)
red.failureCause: Absent behavior assertions, not a missing import, missing tool, or missing dependency

green.stage: After behavior implementation, fixture coverage, and accessibility refinement
green.note: The original 34 tests plus 10 focused fixture/edge tests pass. No RED is claimed for the additional ten tests.

tdd.normalization: Captured TAP retains actual assertions and runner results; absolute repository prefixes, including escaped Windows prefixes in TAP locations, were removed. Trailing spaces on runner-generated blank lines were trimmed after publisher diff-check rejected them. All committed file references are repository-relative.

browser.mode: Real VS Code integrated browser, opened with forceNew=true
browser.isolation: Every interaction used an explicitly owned pageId. No global browser navigation, shared tabs, or global browser close was used.
browser.assertionMethod: Playwright performed actual scoped button clicks and keyboard input, read rendered DOM, and threw on unexpected admission/prediction outcomes. No HTML-string-only substitute was used.

The complete recorded preset/keyboard/optional-gate regression above used primaryVerifiedPageId. Preliminary successful safe-click/read checks also occurred on owned pages ef452b86-84a4-406a-b611-4525007a79af and 4a622eed-2f2a-482e-9cc3-6585b72b93f2.
A later viewport/reset browser probe returned Page not found. It is not counted as passed; no mobile-layout or browser-reset certification is claimed.

publicationPreflightRecovery.firstAttempt: Shared publisher rejected trailing spaces in runner-generated RED TAP blank lines at diff --cached --check, before any commit or tag
publicationPreflightRecovery.remediation: Normalize trailing whitespace only in owned TAP captures, preserve assertion content and result counts, and retry the same shared publisher
publicationPreflightRecovery.gitSafety: No manual index mutation, index-lock removal, stash, reset, branch change, or bypass of the shared publisher

userImpact.reason: No actual users, traffic, journeys, or Azure resources were exercised

iac.reason: SOURCE read-only lesson needs no Azure resource. C001 runtime/auth/hosting approval and separate scaffold/deploy approvals are absent; no provisioning or cloud authentication is inferred.

cleanup.retainedFiles: Only the owned lesson, fixtures, tests, and evidence
cleanup.browser: Private tool handles were intermittently evicted; no shared-tab navigation or global close was attempted
cleanup.recovery: Reset reconstructs the deterministic unready fixture; fixture construction is covered by node:test. Browser reset itself was not successfully observed.

limitations: All readiness inputs, dependency observations, identities, clocks, and traces are synthetic; no Azure endpoint or management API is contacted.
The required pool is explicit. Optional instances are excluded rather than admitted or certified ready.
The aggregate sample is intentionally not a required route-validation check; actual route correctness is unknown.
One readiness snapshot does not prove a stable-readiness window, capacity, compatibility, authentication, user-journey continuity, or race-free real admission.
Actual user impact remains unknown in all five interruption categories; no transition success percentage is computed.
Browser-tool handle/stability limitations and the unverified optional viewport/reset probe are recorded above.
Controller review/acceptance is separate from worker publication. No completion credit is self-awarded.
